title: EUR-CHF — what the recent strength means for cross-border allocations
content: EUR has recovered ~3% vs CHF over the trailing four weeks, primarily on the back of softer Swiss inflation prints and a more dovish ECB tone. For CHF-base-currency clients with material EUR-denominated holdings (Contoso Sustainable Income Fund, Contoso EUR IG Credit, Contoso Real Assets Infrastructure), the unhedged translation effect is positive in CHF terms, contributing approximately +0.8 to +1.2pp to TTM returns. RMs preparing client briefings should explicitly attribute this FX contribution rather than letting it confound underlying performance discussion.
